names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Οκτωβρίου, «Αγία Μαναθώ η παρθένος», with the rank word left off.

The heading of the calendar's name link behind the line for 13 ноября ст. ст., page 2583, «Манефа Кесарийская (Палестинская), дева, мц.», with the grade and the rank words left off; the bracketed word is the calendar's own, the province behind the city. The line itself gives the forename in the genitive and nothing else, «Мц. Манефы».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 13. новембар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Антонин, Никифор, Герман и Манета.“ — «Св. муч.» off, and the fourth of the four bare names is the whole of this form. IT IS A THIRD SPELLING: the folder holds the Greek «Μαναθώ» and the Russian «Манефа Кесарийская (Палестинская)», and this book writes «Манета» with a т where the Russian has ф. Copied as printed and not bent towards either of the others.

death.note: Two calendars, two readings, and the interval holds both. saint.gr: «Η Αγία Μαναθώ μαρτύρησε στα χρόνια του Μαξιμιανού (286 - 305 μ.Χ.)» — the reign and no year. days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 13 ноября ст. ст. closes «(ок. 308)», which is outside that reign; neither is preferred here.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 ноября ст. ст. — «Мц. Манефы (ок. 308).»

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Οκτωβρίου — «Αγία Μαναθώ η παρθένος»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/809/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It names Scythopolis in Palestine as the place of her arrest but gives no year, and no coordinate is proposed here. It adds «Η μνήμη της επαναλαμβάνεται και την 12η Νοεμβρίου» — a second Greek day, recorded here as a note because one attestation row per church is the schema; the four martyrs of `https://www.saint.gr/810/saint.aspx` say she is called Μαραθώ in error on that day. No hymn, no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 26.11.2025 (13. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Антонин, Никифор, Герман и Манета.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, and the heading ENUMERATES FOUR — Антонин, Никифор, Герман, Манета — so four folders take a row off the one quoted line, which is the same four the Russian calendar keeps on this day. `dates` UNTOUCHED: «Пострадаше сви 308. год.» falls inside the «286–305 or about 308» all four folders already hold, and a year inside an interval is no reason to close it. THE PROLOGUE NAMES NO ZEBINAS, where three of these four folders are named for him in English off the Greek calendar’s 20 October company; nothing was renamed on that and no row was added for him, his name not being in this heading or this body. ONE `related` ROW ADDED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: the three men already related to one another and to Zebinas but NOT ONE OF THEM RELATED TO MANATHO, and she related to nobody at all, although this entry and the Russian line put all four in one company — so the four rows missing between her and them are supplied here. The governor who condemned them is named in the book and has no folder.
